jobs.title: Research Fellowship (Experimental Physics)
jobs.description:
What you'll do
 You will join one of CERN’s experimental physics groups, if selected for this Research Fellowship, to develop and lead your own research programme at the frontier of particle physics. You will work in a highly collaborative and international environment, analysing data, contributing to detector design, construction and/or operations, and engaging in the design, execution and interpretation of physics data analyses. You will also be part of CERN’s vibrant scientific community through seminars, workshops, training activities and collaborative projects.
 Your key tasks

• You conduct research in experimental physics within a CERN research group of your choice.

• You contribute to CERN’s experimental physics programme using its large-scale scientific instruments.

• You collaborate with physicists and engineers on studies of particle interactions and related research activities.

• You develop and pursue your research interests within the framework of the Fellowship.
 Your profile

• You hold a strong background in experimental particle physics or a closely related field.

• You have research experience aligned with the scientific activities carried out at CERN’s experimental facilities.

• You are motivated to join a research group and contribute to high-impact scientific work.

• You are eager to develop and pursue your own research interests within the Fellowship framework.
 Your skills

• You have solid analytical and problem-solving skills in the context of experimental physics.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international scientific teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific environment, including presenting and discussing research results.

• You can work independently while contributing to shared research objectives and collaborative projects.

• Application Deadline: 01/09/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva Time)

• Ideal start date: 01/02/2027

• Contract duration: Typically 24 months contract. A small number of outstanding candidates will be offered a 36 month fellowship

• Weekly Working Hours: 40

• Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

• Location: Geneva, Switzerland

• Job Reference: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 7004-7425 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 6 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Please note that CERN Staff members are note eligible to apply for a Fellowship.

• This Vacancy Notice is for Experimental Physics. If instead your field is Applied Science and Engineering, orTheoretical Physics. please consult open positions within the programme available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.
 You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your university (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• A one-page statement of research interests highligthing your plans for the research fellowship (maximum 4,000 characters).

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
 Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 More information about us, here

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa farai
Ti unirai a uno dei gruppi di fisica sperimentale del CERN, se selezionato per questo Research Fellowship, per sviluppare e condurre il tuo programma di ricerca alla frontiera della fisica delle particelle. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e internazionale, analizzando i dati, contribuendo alla progettazione, costruzione e/o operazioni dei rivelatori e impegnando nella progettazione, esecuzione e interpretazione delle analisi dei dati fisici. Sarete anche parte della vivace comunità scientifica del CERN attraverso seminari, workshop, attività di formazione e progetti collaborativi.
I compiti chiave

• Si conduce la ricerca in fisica sperimentale all'interno di un gruppo di ricerca CERN di vostra scelta.

• Contribuisci al programma di fisica sperimentale del CERN utilizzando i suoi strumenti scientifici su larga scala.

• Collabori con fisici e ingegneri su studi di interazioni di particelle e attività di ricerca correlate.

• Sviluppi e persegui i tuoi interessi di ricerca nell'ambito della Fellowship.
Il tuo profilo

• Hai un forte background nella fisica delle particelle sperimentali o in un campo strettamente correlato.

• Hai esperienza di ricerca allineata con le attività scientifiche svolte presso le strutture sperimentali del CERN.

• Siete motivati a unire un gruppo di ricerca e contribuire al lavoro scientifico ad alto impatto.

• Siete desiderosi di sviluppare e perseguire i vostri interessi di ricerca all'interno del quadro di Fellowship.
Le tue competenze

• Hai solide competenze analitiche e problem solving nel contesto della fisica sperimentale.

• Sei in grado di lavorare in collaborazione all'interno di grandi e internazionali team scientifici.

• Si comunica efficacemente in un ambiente scientifico, tra cui presentare e discutere i risultati della ricerca.

• È possibile lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo a obiettivi di ricerca condivisi e progetti collaborativi.

• Scadenza domanda: 01/09/2026 a 23:59 (Ginevra Tempo)

• Data di inizio ideale: 01/02/2027

• Durata del contratto: tipicamente contratto 24 mesi. Un piccolo numero di candidati eccezionali sarà offerto una borsa di studio di 36 mesi

• Ore lavorative settimanali: 40

• Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite

• Ubicazione: Ginevra, Svizzera

• Riferimento del lavoro: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 7004-7425 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Assicurarsi di soddisfare i criteri di ammissibilità

• Con la scadenza della domanda, si dispone di un PhD (o lo otterrà entro sei mesi), e non più di 6 anni di esperienza di ricerca dopo il completamento del dottorato di ricerca.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• Siete pregati di notare che i membri dello Staff del CERN possono richiedere un Fellowship.

• Questa Avviso di Vacancy è per la fisica sperimentale. Se invece il vostro campo è scienza applicata e ingegneria, o fisica teorica. si prega di consultare posizioni aperte all'interno del programma disponibile nella pagina del Programma di Fellowship .

• Si prega di prestare attenzione ai criteri e ai requisiti aggiuntivi per questa specifica posizione e menzionato sopra.
Avrete bisogno di questi documenti per completare la vostra applicazione

• Il tuo CV (inglese o francese)

• Una copia del diploma più rilevante o un certificato di successo dalla tua università (se non hai ancora il diploma di carta)

• Una dichiarazione di una pagina di interessi di ricerca ad alta fedeltà i vostri piani per la borsa di ricerca (massimo 4.000 caratteri).

• Tre recenti lettere di raccomandazione (non più di un anno al termine della domanda) che delineano i vostri risultati accademici e/o professionali, indicando il rapporto professionale dall'arbitro a voi. Dopo aver presentato la tua domanda, riceverai un link di presentazione per inoltrare i tuoi arbitri; le lettere devono essere caricate confidenziali prima della data di chiusura (il caricamento delle lettere è possibile ma scoraggiato).
Scoprite un mondo dove l'impossibile è reso possibile!

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you'll do
You will join one of CERN’s experimental physics groups, if selected for this Research Fellowship, to develop and lead your own research programme at the frontier of particle physics. You will work in a highly collaborative and international environment, analysing data, contributing to detector design, construction and/or operations, and engaging in the design, execution and interpretation of physics data analyses. You will also be part of CERN’s vibrant scientific community through seminars, workshops, training activities and collaborative projects.
Your key tasks

• You conduct research in experimental physics within a CERN research group of your choice.

• You contribute to CERN’s experimental physics programme using its large-scale scientific instruments.

• You collaborate with physicists and engineers on studies of particle interactions and related research activities.

• You develop and pursue your research interests within the framework of the Fellowship.
Your profile

• You hold a strong background in experimental particle physics or a closely related field.

• You have research experience aligned with the scientific activities carried out at CERN’s experimental facilities.

• You are motivated to join a research group and contribute to high-impact scientific work.

• You are eager to develop and pursue your own research interests within the Fellowship framework.
Your skills

• You have solid analytical and problem-solving skills in the context of experimental physics.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international scientific teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific environment, including presenting and discussing research results.

• You can work independently while contributing to shared research objectives and collaborative projects.

• Application Deadline: 01/09/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva Time)

• Ideal start date: 01/02/2027

• Contract duration: Typically 24 months contract. A small number of outstanding candidates will be offered a 36 month fellowship

• Weekly Working Hours: 40

• Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

• Location: Geneva, Switzerland

• Job Reference: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 7004-7425 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 6 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Please note that CERN Staff members are note eligible to apply for a Fellowship.

• This Vacancy Notice is for Experimental Physics. If instead your field is Applied Science and Engineering, orTheoretical Physics. please consult open positions within the programme available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.
You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your university (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• A one-page statement of research interests highligthing your plans for the research fellowship (maximum 4,000 characters).

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
More information about us, here
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was du tun wirst
Sie werden einer der experimentellen Physikgruppen des CERN beitreten, wenn Sie für dieses Forschungsstipendium ausgewählt werden, um Ihr eigenes Forschungsprogramm an der Grenze der Teilchenphysik zu entwickeln und zu leiten. Sie arbeiten in einem hochgradig kooperativen und internationalen Umfeld, analysieren Daten, tragen zum Detektordesign, zum Bau und / oder zum Betrieb bei und beteiligen sich an der Gestaltung, Ausführung und Interpretation von physikalischen Datenanalysen. Sie werden auch Teil der lebendigen wissenschaftlichen Gemeinschaft des CERN durch Seminare, Workshops, Schulungsaktivitäten und Kooperationsprojekte sein.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Sie betreiben Forschung in experimenteller Physik in einer CERN-Forschungsgruppe Ihrer Wahl.

• Sie tragen zum experimentellen Physikprogramm des CERN bei, indem Sie seine groß angelegten wissenschaftlichen Instrumente nutzen.

• Sie arbeiten mit Physikern und Ingenieuren an Studien zu Teilchenwechselwirkungen und verwandten Forschungsaktivitäten zusammen.

• Sie entwickeln und verfolgen Ihre Forschungsinteressen im Rahmen des Fellowships.
Dein Profil

• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund in der experimentellen Teilchenphysik oder einem eng verwandten Gebiet.

• Sie haben Forschungserfahrung, die mit den wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten in den experimentellen Einrichtungen des CERN übereinstimmt.

• Sie sind motiviert, einer Forschungsgruppe beizutreten und zu einer wirkungsvollen wissenschaftlichen Arbeit beizutragen.

• Sie sind bestrebt, Ihre eigenen Forschungsinteressen im Rahmen des Fellowship zu entwickeln und zu verfolgen.
Ihre Fähigkeiten

• Sie haben solide analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten im Kontext der experimentellen Physik.

• Sie können in großen, internationalen wissenschaftlichen Teams zusammenarbeiten.

• Sie kommunizieren effektiv in einem wissenschaftlichen Umfeld, einschließlich der Präsentation und Diskussion von Forschungsergebnissen.

• Sie können unabhängig arbeiten und gleichzeitig zu gemeinsamen Forschungszielen und Verbundprojekten beitragen.

• Bewerbungsschluss: 01/09/2026 um 23:59 Uhr (Genfer Zeit)

• Ideales Startdatum: 01/02/2027

• Vertragsdauer: Typischerweise 24 Monate Vertrag. Eine kleine Anzahl von ausstehenden Kandidaten wird ein 36-monatiges Stipendium angeboten.

• Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit: 40

• Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort

• Standort: Genf, Schweiz

• Stellenbeschreibung: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Globale Vorteile

• Ein monatliches Stipendium zwischen 7004-7425 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (steuerfrei), abhängig von Ihrem Abschluss.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.

• On-the-job und formale Ausbildung einschließlich Sprachunterricht.
Achten Sie darauf, die Förderkriterien zu erfüllen

• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie einen Doktortitel (oder erhalten ihn innerhalb von sechs Monaten) und nicht mehr als 6 Jahre Forschungserfahrung nach Abschluss Ihres PhD-Abschlusses.

• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.

• Bitte beachten Sie, dass Mitglieder des CERN-Personals berechtigt sind, sich für ein Fellowship zu bewerben.

• Diese Vacancy Notice ist für Experimentelle Physik. Wenn stattdessen Ihr Feld Applied Science and Engineering oder Theoretische Physik ist. Bitte konsultieren Sie offene Stellen innerhalb des Programms, die auf der Seite des Forschungsstipendiums verfügbar sind.

• Bitte beachten Sie die zusätzlichen Kriterien und Anforderungen für diese spezifische Position und oben erwähnt.
Sie benötigen diese Dokumente, um Ihre Bewerbung abzuschließen

• Ihr Lebenslauf (Englisch oder Französisch)

• Eine Kopie Ihres wichtigsten Diploms oder eine Leistungsbescheinigung Ihrer Universität (falls Sie noch kein Papierdiplom haben)

• Eine einseitige Erklärung der Forschungsinteressen, die Ihre Pläne für das Forschungsstipendium hochhält (maximal 4.000 Zeichen).

• Drei aktuelle Empfehlungsschreiben (nicht älter als ein Jahr zum Bewerbungsschluss), in denen Ihre akademischen und / oder beruflichen Leistungen dargelegt werden und die berufliche Beziehung des Schiedsrichters zu Ihnen angegeben wird. Nachdem Sie Ihre Bewerbung eingereicht haben, erhalten Sie einen Einreichungslink zur Weiterleitung an Ihre Schiedsrichter; Briefe müssen vor dem Abschlussdatum vertraulich hochgeladen werden (das Hochladen von Briefen selbst ist möglich, aber entmutigt).

Ce que tu vas faire

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et international, en analysant les données, en contribuant à la conception, à la construction et/ou aux opérations des détecteurs, et en participant à la conception, à l'exécution et à l'interprétation des analyses de données physiques. Vous ferez également partie de la communauté scientifique dynamique du CERN à travers des séminaires, des ateliers, des activités de formation et des projets collaboratifs.
Vos tâches clés

• Vous effectuez des recherches en physique expérimentale au sein d'un groupe de recherche du CERN de votre choix.

• Vous contribuez au programme de physique expérimentale du CERN en utilisant ses instruments scientifiques à grande échelle.

• Vous collaborez avec des physiciens et des ingénieurs à des études sur les interactions des particules et les activités de recherche connexes.

• Vous développez et poursuivez vos intérêts de recherche dans le cadre de la Bourse.
Votre profil

• Vous avez une solide formation en physique expérimentale des particules ou un domaine étroitement lié.

• Vous avez une expérience de recherche alignée sur les activités scientifiques menées dans les installations expérimentales du CERN.

• Vous êtes motivé à rejoindre un groupe de recherche et à contribuer à des travaux scientifiques à haut impact.

• Vous êtes impatient de développer et de poursuivre vos propres intérêts de recherche dans le cadre de la Bourse.
Vos compétences

• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes dans le contexte de la physique expérimentale.

• Vous pouvez travailler en collaboration au sein de grandes équipes scientifiques internationales.

• Vous communiquez efficacement dans un environnement scientifique, notamment en présentant et en discutant des résultats de recherche.

• Vous pouvez travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant à des objectifs de recherche communs et à des projets collaboratifs.

• Une allocation mensuelle entre 7004-7425 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant (SY-AR-2026-167-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 As an Administrative Assistant in the Accelerator Systems Department ( SY ), you will support the effective planning and administration of one of CERN's largest technical departments. Working closely with the Departmental Planning Officer, Administration Officer and colleagues across CERN, you will coordinate key administrative and resource management activities.
 Functions

• Coordinate departmental administrative activities, ensuring efficient service delivery and compliance with CERN's rules and procedures.

• Support workforce planning and personnel administration across the employee lifecycle, including contracts, arrivals, departures, travel and related processes.

• Maintain accurate planning, personnel and budget information to support effective resource management and informed decision-making.

• Prepare reports, analyses and management information, ensuring the quality and integrity of administrative data.

• Manage departmental documentation and information systems, maintaining accurate records and planning tools.

• Provide proactive, confidential administrative support to managers and colleagues, building effective relationships across CERN.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of administrative processes and support service continuity across the administrative team.

Higher administrative diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Administration or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience of administrative work in a team, preferably in an international environment.

• Experience supporting planning, budgeting or resource management activities.
 Technical competencies:

• Personnel and material resources planning.

• Knowledge of administrative rules and procedures.

• Use of office software packages, including advanced Excel.

• Secretarial work.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Communicating Effectively: providing others with timely information.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Hybrid
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: SY-AR-2026-167-LD
 Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
 Benchmark Job Title: Process/Services Assistant

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
In qualità di Assistente Amministrativo del Dipartimento Sistemi Acceleratori (SY ), supporterai l'efficace pianificazione e amministrazione di uno dei più grandi dipartimenti tecnici del CERN. Lavorando a stretto contatto con l'Amministratore Delegato, l'Amministratore e i colleghi di tutto il CERN, coordina le principali attività amministrative e di gestione delle risorse.
Funzioni

• Coordinate le attività amministrative dipartimentali, assicurando un servizio efficiente e il rispetto delle regole e delle procedure del CERN.

• Sostenere la pianificazione della forza lavoro e l'amministrazione del personale attraverso il ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, compresi i contratti, gli arrivi, le partenze, i viaggi e i processi correlati.

• Mantenere la pianificazione accurata, il personale e le informazioni di bilancio per sostenere la gestione efficace delle risorse e il processo decisionale informato.

• Preparare report, analisi e informazioni di gestione, garantendo la qualità e l'integrità dei dati amministrativi.

• Gestisci documentazione e sistemi informativi dipartimentali, mantenendo registri accurati e strumenti di pianificazione.

• Fornire un supporto amministrativo proattivo e confidenziale a dirigenti e colleghi, costruendo relazioni efficaci in tutto il CERN.

• Contribuisci al miglioramento continuo dei processi amministrativi e alla continuità del servizio di supporto in tutto il team amministrativo.

Più alto diploma amministrativo o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'Amministrazione o in un campo relativo.

Esperienza:

• Provata esperienza di lavoro amministrativo in un team, preferibilmente in un ambiente internazionale.

• Esperienza che supporta le attività di pianificazione, budgeting o gestione delle risorse.
Competenze tecniche:

• Pianificazione del personale e delle risorse materiali.

• Conoscenza delle regole e delle procedure amministrative.

• Utilizzo di pacchetti software di ufficio, tra cui Excel avanzato.

• Lavoro di segretariato.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo cosciente e affidabile; fornire promesse.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.

• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci.

• Gestire il Sé: lavorare bene autonomamente; svolgere attività e compiti senza sollecitare.

• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire ad altri informazioni tempestive.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 31.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Grado di lavoro: 3-4
Riferimento del lavoro: SY-AR-2026-167-LD
Campo di lavoro: Servizi di supporto (Finance, HR, Legale, Procurement)
Titolo del lavoro di Benchmark: Process/Services Assistant

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.

La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
As an Administrative Assistant in the Accelerator Systems Department ( SY ), you will support the effective planning and administration of one of CERN's largest technical departments. Working closely with the Departmental Planning Officer, Administration Officer and colleagues across CERN, you will coordinate key administrative and resource management activities.
Functions

• Coordinate departmental administrative activities, ensuring efficient service delivery and compliance with CERN's rules and procedures.

• Support workforce planning and personnel administration across the employee lifecycle, including contracts, arrivals, departures, travel and related processes.

• Maintain accurate planning, personnel and budget information to support effective resource management and informed decision-making.

• Prepare reports, analyses and management information, ensuring the quality and integrity of administrative data.

• Manage departmental documentation and information systems, maintaining accurate records and planning tools.

• Provide proactive, confidential administrative support to managers and colleagues, building effective relationships across CERN.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of administrative processes and support service continuity across the administrative team.

Higher administrative diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Administration or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience of administrative work in a team, preferably in an international environment.

• Experience supporting planning, budgeting or resource management activities.
Technical competencies:

• Personnel and material resources planning.

• Knowledge of administrative rules and procedures.

• Use of office software packages, including advanced Excel.

• Secretarial work.
Behavioural competencies:

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Communicating Effectively: providing others with timely information.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: SY-AR-2026-167-LD
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark Job Title: Process/Services Assistant

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Abteilungsplanungsbeauftragten, dem Verwaltungsbeamten und den Kollegen des CERN koordinieren Sie wichtige Verwaltungs- und Ressourcenmanagementaktivitäten.

• Koordinieren Sie die administrativen Aktivitäten der Abteilungen, um eine effiziente Servicebereitstellung und die Einhaltung der Regeln und Verfahren des CERN sicherzustellen.

• Unterstützung der Personalplanung und -verwaltung über den gesamten Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus hinweg, einschließlich Verträge, Ankunft, Abreise, Reise und damit verbundene Prozesse.

• Pflegen Sie genaue Planungs-, Personal- und Budgetinformationen, um ein effektives Ressourcenmanagement und eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

• Erstellen Sie Berichte, Analysen und Managementinformationen, um die Qualität und Integrität der Verwaltungsdaten zu gewährleisten.

• Verwalten Sie die Dokumentations- und Informationssysteme der Abteilung und pflegen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen und Planungswerkzeuge.

• Proaktive, vertrauliche administrative Unterstützung für Manager und Kollegen und Aufbau effektiver Beziehungen im gesamten CERN.

• Tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Verwaltungsprozesse bei und unterstützen Sie die Servicekontinuität im gesamten Verwaltungsteam.

Höheres Verwaltungsdiplom oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Verwaltung oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der administrativen Arbeit in einem Team, vorzugsweise in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Planungs-, Budgetierungs- oder Ressourcenmanagementaktivitäten.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Personal- und Materialplanung.

• Kenntnis der Verwaltungsvorschriften und -verfahren.

• Verwendung von Office-Softwarepaketen, einschließlich Advanced Excel.

• Sekretariatsarbeit.
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: gewissenhaft und zuverlässig arbeiten; Versprechen halten.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: schnelle und einfallsreiche Anpassung an sich verändernde Prioritäten und Anforderungen.

• Arbeiten in Teams: Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver und effektiver Arbeitsbeziehungen.

• Selbstmanagement: gut autonom arbeiten; Aktivitäten und Aufgaben übernehmen, ohne zu veranlassen.

• Effektiv kommunizieren: Andere rechtzeitig informieren.

Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.

Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.

Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Hybrid
Job Grade: 3-4
Berufsbezeichnung: SY-AR-2026-167-LD
Arbeitsbereich: Support Services (Finanzen, HR, Recht, Beschaffung)
Benchmark Job Title: Prozess-/Dienstleister

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.

En tant qu'adjoint administratif au Département des systèmes d'accélération (SY), vous soutiendrez la planification et l'administration efficaces de l'un des plus grands départements techniques du CERN. • Planification des ressources humaines et matérielles.

Anglais ou français parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre l'autre langue.

Domaine d ' activité : Services d ' appui (finances, ressources humaines, services juridiques, achats)
Titre du poste-repère : Assistant aux processus et aux services

Avantages globaux

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !

jobs.description:
As a Construction Project Engineer within the Site and Civil Engineering Department (Project Portfolio Management Group), you will contribute to the delivery of complex construction projects at CERN. Reporting to a CERN Project Manager, you will coordinate site activities, manage interfaces with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure smooth execution while meeting technical, scheduling, budgetary, and safety objectives
 Your responsibilities

• Supervise the execution of construction works and ensure, in liaison with the relevant external consultants (architects, structural and MEP engineers), that all works comply with contractual drawings and specifications.

• Ensure that all safety measures are properly implemented and adhered to on the worksites, while identifying potential issues, preventing their occurrence and managing the remediation of defects.

• Participate in testing, commissioning and taking-over activities to ensure the smooth handover of the works.

• Contribute to the design, coordination and procurement phases of new projects in close collaboration with the project manager, including monitoring consultants' deliverables during the construction phase.

• Coordinate on-site interfaces between contractors and CERN specialised services, organise the worksite according to the construction schedule, and monitor the progress, quality and budget of the works in close collaboration with the project manager.
 Your profile

• Experience in Civil Engineering design or Construction works on site.

• Experience in coordination.
 Skills

• Proficiency in the MS Office suite including MS project.

• Familiarity with construction project management tools and methodologies.

• Quality control, writing procedures, reports and minutes.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Civil Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 25.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-January-2027
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: SCE-PPM-CS-2026-92-GRAP
 Field of work: Civil Engineering
 Benchmark job: 200010 - Civil Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

Le tue responsabilità

• Esperienza nella progettazione di ingegneria civile o lavori di costruzione in loco.

• Esperienza in coordinamento.

• Proficienza nella suite MS Office, incluso il progetto MS.

• Familiarità con strumenti di gestione dei progetti di costruzione e metodologie.

• Controllo di qualità, procedure di scrittura, relazioni e minuti.

• Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;

• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 25.08.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali
Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite

Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
Riferimento del lavoro: SCE-PPM-CS-2026-92-GRAP
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria civile
Lavoro Benchmark: 200010 - Ingegnere Civile

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 6372-7004 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

Durante il vostro soggiorno, sarete in congedo dal vostro istituto di casa, perseguire la ricerca o attività scientifiche correlate all'insegnamento nel vostro campo di competenza, e contribuirà la vostra esperienza e la conoscenza alla vita scientifica dell'Organizzazione.

• Siete attivamente impegnati nel lavoro scientifico nel vostro campo di competenza.

• Sei interessato a mantenere stretti legami con la comunità fisica teorica internazionale.

• Lei dimostra forti capacità di ragionamento analitico e teorico.

• Siete in grado di impegnarsi in discussioni scientifiche di alto livello e scambio di conoscenze.

• Lavorate comodamente in un ambiente internazionale e ricercato.

• Si comunica chiaramente e professionalmente in un contesto scientifico, in inglese e/o francese.

• Spese di viaggio a Ginevra dopo l'adesione al CERN, a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. jobs.title: Test & Measurement Engineer (BE-CEM-MTA-2026-168-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 You will help design, integrate, and operate complex test and measurement systems in cryogenic, electrical, and controls environments.

Your work will support the characterisation and validation of superconducting magnets and related components under demanding protection, synchronisation, and reliability requirements. You will join CERN’s Beams Department, working in the Controls Electronics and Mechatronics Group and the Measurement, Test and Analysis section. The role involves developing modern control and data acquisition systems using LABVIEW, C++, Python, and CERN controls technologies.
 Functions

• Design, develop and validate software, controls and data acquisition architectures for superconducting magnet, cable and coil test benches, from functional requirements to acceptance tests.

• Develop, maintain and integrate applications in C++, Python, LabVIEW and CERN controls technologies, including FESA/CMW equipment control interfaces for front-end and test-bench systems.

• Integrate and support electronics, instrumentation, timing, interlocks, protection and data acquisition hardware on Linux-based, real-time and front-end platforms.

• Operate, monitor, debug and improve complex superconducting magnet test systems, including cryogenic measurements, high-current/high-voltage tests, fast transients, quench detection and safe data acquisition.

• Collaborate with CERN teams responsible for magnets, powering, protection, cryogenics, electronics and controls; document and present results, and promote good software engineering practices, including GitLab, code reviews, automated testing and clear documentation.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience in C++ and Python software design and development for data acquisition, automation, testing, analysis or controls applications.

• Experience developing software for hardware control and data acquisition systems, preferably on Linux-based, real-time or front-end platforms.

• Knowledge of CERN accelerator controls concepts and technologies, such as FESA, CMW, device-property models, timing systems or equipment control interfaces, would be a strong asset.

• Familiarity with electronics, instrumentation, signal conditioning, acquisition hardware and troubleshooting of measurement chains; experience with LabVIEW, LabVIEW RT or LabVIEW FPGA would be an asset.

• Understanding of superconducting magnet or cryogenic/electrical testing challenges, including quench detection, high-voltage protection, electrical insulation tests, noise, synchronisation, interlocks and safe acquisition.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge and deployment of computing hardware.

• Testing and measurement of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.

• Measurement and analysis of magnets.

• Design, modelling and measurement of superconductors for magnets.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Solving Problems: producing workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Achieving Results: driving work / projects along and seeing them through to their conclusion.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: BE-CEM-MTA-2026-168-LD
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Aiuterai la progettazione, l'integrazione e l'utilizzo di sistemi di test e misura complessi in ambienti criogenici, elettrici e di controllo.

Il vostro lavoro supporterà la caratterizzazione e la validazione di magneti superconduttori e componenti correlati in condizioni di protezione, sincronizzazione e affidabilità. Ti unirai al dipartimento di Beams del CERN, lavorando nel gruppo Controls Electronics e Mechatronics e nella sezione Misura, Test e Analisi. Il ruolo consiste nello sviluppo di sistemi di controllo e acquisizione dati moderni utilizzando tecnologie di controllo LABVIEW, C++, Python e CERN.
Funzioni

• Progettare, sviluppare e convalidare software, controlli e architetture di acquisizione dati per i banchi di prova magnete, cavo e bobina superconduttori, dai requisiti funzionali ai test di accettazione.

• Sviluppare, mantenere e integrare le applicazioni nelle tecnologie di controllo C++, Python, LabVIEW e CERN, comprese le interfacce di controllo delle apparecchiature FESA/CMW per sistemi di front-end e test-bench.

• Integra e supporta l'elettronica, la strumentazione, la tempistica, gli interlock, la protezione e l'hardware di acquisizione dati su piattaforme basate su Linux, in tempo reale e front-end.

• Operare, monitorare, debug e migliorare i complessi sistemi di test magneti superconduttivi, comprese le misurazioni criogeniche, test ad alta corrente/alta tensione, transienti veloci, rilevamento di quench e acquisizione dati sicura.

• Collaborare con i team CERN responsabili di magneti, alimentazione, protezione, criogenia, elettronica e controlli; documentare e presentare i risultati e promuovere buone pratiche di ingegneria del software, tra cui GitLab, recensioni dei codici, test automatizzati e documentazione chiara.

Laurea magistrale o dottorato o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della Scienza informatica, ingegneria del software, ingegneria elettronica, ingegneria informatica, fisica applicata o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza comprovata nella progettazione e sviluppo di software C++ e Python per applicazioni di acquisizione, automazione, test, analisi o controlli.

• Scopri lo sviluppo di software per il controllo hardware e sistemi di acquisizione dati, preferibilmente su piattaforme Linux, in tempo reale o front-end.

• La conoscenza dell'acceleratore del CERN controlla concetti e tecnologie, come FESA, CMW, modelli di proprietà dei dispositivi, sistemi di temporizzazione o interfacce di controllo delle apparecchiature, sarebbe un bene forte.

• La familiarità con l'elettronica, la strumentazione, il condizionamento del segnale, l'hardware di acquisizione e la risoluzione dei problemi delle catene di misura; l'esperienza con LabVIEW, LabVIEW RT o LabVIEW FPGA sarebbe un bene.

• Comprensione di superconduttori magneti o sfide di test criogenici/elettrici, tra cui il rilevamento di quench, protezione ad alta tensione, test di isolamento elettrico, rumore, sincronizzazione, interlock e acquisizione sicura.
Competenze tecniche:

• Conoscenza e distribuzione dell'hardware di calcolo.

• Test e misurazione dell'elettronica front-end per sensori e trasduttori analogici.

• Misurazione e analisi dei magneti.

• Progettazione, modellazione e misura di superconduttori per magneti.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Lavorare in team: lavorare bene in gruppi e adattarsi prontamente a un team; partecipare pienamente e assumere un ruolo attivo nelle attività del team.

• Comunicare efficacemente: esprimere opinioni, idee e suggerimenti con convinzione e in modo logico/strutturato; mantenere al punto.

• Risolvere i Problemi: produrre soluzioni lavorabili e tempestive che soddisfano i requisiti.

• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo cosciente e affidabile; fornire promesse.

• Risultati: lavoro di guida / progetti lungo e vederli attraverso alla loro conclusione.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 31.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (3 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Esposizione a campi elettromagnetici in determinate condizioni di esposizione

• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale.
Grado di lavoro: 6-7
Riferimento del lavoro: BE-CEM-MTA-2026-168-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica
Benchmark Titolo di lavoro: Ingegnere di calcolo

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

Introduction
You will help design, integrate, and operate complex test and measurement systems in cryogenic, electrical, and controls environments.

Your work will support the characterisation and validation of superconducting magnets and related components under demanding protection, synchronisation, and reliability requirements. You will join CERN’s Beams Department, working in the Controls Electronics and Mechatronics Group and the Measurement, Test and Analysis section. The role involves developing modern control and data acquisition systems using LABVIEW, C++, Python, and CERN controls technologies.
Functions

• Design, develop and validate software, controls and data acquisition architectures for superconducting magnet, cable and coil test benches, from functional requirements to acceptance tests.

• Develop, maintain and integrate applications in C++, Python, LabVIEW and CERN controls technologies, including FESA/CMW equipment control interfaces for front-end and test-bench systems.

• Integrate and support electronics, instrumentation, timing, interlocks, protection and data acquisition hardware on Linux-based, real-time and front-end platforms.

• Operate, monitor, debug and improve complex superconducting magnet test systems, including cryogenic measurements, high-current/high-voltage tests, fast transients, quench detection and safe data acquisition.

• Collaborate with CERN teams responsible for magnets, powering, protection, cryogenics, electronics and controls; document and present results, and promote good software engineering practices, including GitLab, code reviews, automated testing and clear documentation.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics or a related field.

Experience:

• Proven experience in C++ and Python software design and development for data acquisition, automation, testing, analysis or controls applications.

• Experience developing software for hardware control and data acquisition systems, preferably on Linux-based, real-time or front-end platforms.

• Knowledge of CERN accelerator controls concepts and technologies, such as FESA, CMW, device-property models, timing systems or equipment control interfaces, would be a strong asset.

• Familiarity with electronics, instrumentation, signal conditioning, acquisition hardware and troubleshooting of measurement chains; experience with LabVIEW, LabVIEW RT or LabVIEW FPGA would be an asset.

• Understanding of superconducting magnet or cryogenic/electrical testing challenges, including quench detection, high-voltage protection, electrical insulation tests, noise, synchronisation, interlocks and safe acquisition.
Technical competencies:

• Knowledge and deployment of computing hardware.

• Testing and measurement of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.

• Measurement and analysis of magnets.

• Design, modelling and measurement of superconductors for magnets.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Solving Problems: producing workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Achieving Results: driving work / projects along and seeing them through to their conclusion.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: BE-CEM-MTA-2026-168-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Présentation
Vous aiderez à concevoir, à intégrer et à utiliser des systèmes d'essai et de mesure complexes dans des environnements cryogéniques, électriques et de contrôle.

Votre travail soutiendra la caractérisation et la validation d'aimants supraconducteurs et de composants connexes sous des exigences exigeantes de protection, de synchronisation et de fiabilité. Vous rejoindrez le département des faisceaux du CERN, travaillant dans le groupe Contrôles Électronique et Mécatronique et la section Mesure, Test et Analyse. Le rôle consiste à développer des systèmes modernes de contrôle et d'acquisition de données en utilisant les technologies de contrôle LABVIEW, C++, Python et CERN.
Fonctions

• Concevoir, développer et valider des architectures de logiciels, de commandes et d'acquisition de données pour les bancs d'essai d'aimants, de câbles et de bobines supraconducteurs, des exigences fonctionnelles aux essais d'acceptation.

• Développer, entretenir et intégrer des applications dans les technologies de contrôle C++, Python, LabVIEW et CERN, y compris les interfaces de contrôle des équipements FESA/CMW pour les systèmes frontal et test-bench.

• Intégrez et supportez l'électronique, l'instrumentation, le timing, les interlocks, la protection et le matériel d'acquisition de données sur les plateformes Linux, en temps réel et front-end.

• Exploiter, surveiller, déboguer et améliorer les systèmes complexes d'essai d'aimant supraconducteur, y compris les mesures cryogéniques, les essais à haute tension, les transitoires rapides, la détection d'extinction et l'acquisition de données sûres.

• Collaborer avec les équipes du CERN responsables des aimants, de l'alimentation, de la protection, de la cryogénique, de l'électronique et des contrôles; documenter et présenter les résultats et promouvoir de bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris GitLab, des examens de code, des essais automatisés et une documentation claire.

Maîtrise ou doctorat ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine de l'informatique, génie logiciel, génie électronique, génie informatique, physique appliquée ou un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Expérience éprouvée en conception et développement de logiciels C++ et Python pour l'acquisition de données, l'automatisation, les tests, l'analyse ou les applications de contrôle.

• Expérience de développement de logiciels pour le contrôle matériel et les systèmes d'acquisition de données, de préférence sur des plateformes Linux, en temps réel ou front-end.

• La connaissance des concepts et des technologies de commande de l'accélérateur du CERN, tels que FESA, CMW, les modèles de propriété d'appareils, les systèmes de chronométrage ou les interfaces de commande d'équipement, serait un atout important.

• Connaissance de l'électronique, de l'instrumentation, du conditionnement des signaux, du matériel d'acquisition et du dépannage des chaînes de mesure; l'expérience de LabVIEW, LabVIEW RT ou LabVIEW FPGA serait un atout.

• Compréhension des défis de l'aimant supraconducteur ou de l'essai cryogénique/électrique, y compris la détection de l'extinction, la protection à haute tension, les essais d'isolation électrique, le bruit, la synchronisation, les interblocs et l'acquisition en toute sécurité.
Compétences techniques:

• Connaissance et déploiement du matériel informatique.

• Essai et mesure de l'électronique frontale pour capteurs analogiques et transducteurs.

• Mesure et analyse des aimants.

• Conception, modélisation et mesure de supraconducteurs pour aimants.

jobs.title: Equipment Management Database Specialist (EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility.  The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. It also provides support to colleagues across the CMS experiment in keeping the database up to date by preparing dedicated documentation and labelling for the services installation campaign, ensuring that equipment can be accurately identified, tracked and managed throughout its lifecycle.
 Functions

• Ensure the consistency, accuracy and integrity of the CMS Equipment Management Database by synchronising it with the physical installation and decommissioning of equipment.

• Act as the interface between field inventory activities of CMS teams and the Equipment Management Database, ensuring that all equipment installations, removals and modifications are accurately reflected in the system.

• Maintain, support and enhance the Equipment Management Database and its applications, ensuring their reliability and long-term sustainability while developing new features, dashboards and visualisation tools for equipment traceability, data quality monitoring and reporting.

• Drive continuous improvements to the usability, functionality and efficiency of the Equipment Management Database by streamlining the registration and management of equipment, cables and other assets, and enhancing data management and asset traceability across the CMS experiment.

• Supporting work on the field, to ensure that the operational aspects of asset installation run smoothly for the CMS experiment and that there is coherence between installed equipment and services and the database inventory

• Collaborate with the CERN Enterprise Asset Management service and ensure the inter-operationality of processes within the CERN-wide infrastructure and applications.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or Applied Physics or a related field.

Experience:

• Experience with relational databases and SQL.

• Experience with web application development, using for example Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, client-oriented APIs.

• Experience monitoring data quality and ensuring data consistency between physical assets and the digital inventory system.

• Experience with engineering equipment, scientific infrastructure, or large-scale technical installations.

• Ability to develop dashboards and application features.

• Proactive in improving processes and application functionality.

• Familiarity with the CMS Experimental and upgrade program is an advantage.

• Ability to bridge operational activities in the field with IT systems and interface CERN asset management procedures.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge of database and/or data mining architectures and technologies.

• Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.

• Decommissioning and disposal of detector components and systems.

• Development of application software.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: defining clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.

• Solving Problems: addressing complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.

• Learning and Sharing Knowledge: proposing ways to improve or streamline existing procedures, processes and methodologies.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 31.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (4 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 6-7
 Job reference: EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD
 Field of work: Data Science & Data Analytics
 Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
Il ruolo è responsabile per garantire che tutte le attrezzature installate o rimosse durante CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) siano accuratamente registrate nel database di gestione apparecchiature CMS (EMdb). Essendo l'interfaccia tra l'inventario fisico e il database, il post-holder assicura la coerenza dei dati, mantiene e migliora il database e le sue applicazioni associate, e sviluppa strumenti per migliorare la visualizzazione e l'accessibilità dei dati. Il ruolo combina una forte esperienza IT con una comprensione delle apparecchiature e dei processi di gestione patrimoniale dell'esperimento CMS. Fornisce anche supporto ai colleghi di tutto l'esperimento CMS per mantenere aggiornato il database preparando la documentazione dedicata e l'etichettatura per la campagna di installazione dei servizi, assicurando che l'apparecchiatura possa essere accuratamente identificata, tracciata e gestita durante il suo ciclo di vita.
Funzioni

• Assicurare la coerenza, l'accuratezza e l'integrità del database di gestione attrezzature CMS sincronizzandolo con l'installazione fisica e la decommissione di apparecchiature.

• Atto come l'interfaccia tra le attività di inventario di campo dei team CMS e il database di gestione attrezzature, assicurando che tutte le installazioni di attrezzature, le rimozioni e le modifiche siano accuratamente riflesse nel sistema.

• Mantenere, supportare e migliorare il Database Gestione attrezzature e le sue applicazioni, garantendo la loro affidabilità e sostenibilità a lungo termine, sviluppando nuove funzionalità, dashboard e strumenti di visualizzazione per la tracciabilità delle attrezzature, monitoraggio della qualità dei dati e reporting.

• Miglioramento continuo dell'usabilità, della funzionalità e dell'efficienza del database di gestione delle attrezzature, semplificando la registrazione e la gestione di apparecchiature, cavi e altri beni, migliorando la gestione dei dati e la tracciabilità degli asset attraverso l'esperimento CMS.

• Sostegno ai lavori sul campo, al fine di garantire che gli aspetti operativi dell'installazione degli asset funzionino senza intoppi per l'esperimento CMS e che vi sia coerenza tra attrezzature e servizi installati e l'inventario del database

• Collabora con il servizio CERN Enterprise Asset Management e assicura l'interoperatività dei processi all'interno dell'infrastruttura e delle applicazioni CERN.

Laurea magistrale o dottorato o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della Scienza informatica o fisica applicata o un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Esperienza con database relazionali e SQL.

• Esperienza con lo sviluppo di applicazioni web, utilizzando per esempio Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, API orientate al cliente.

• Scopri la qualità dei dati di monitoraggio e la coerenza dei dati tra le attività fisiche e il sistema di inventario digitale.

• Esperienza con attrezzature ingegneristiche, infrastrutture scientifiche o impianti tecnici di grandi dimensioni.

• Capacità di sviluppare dashboard e funzionalità applicative.

• Proattivo nel miglioramento dei processi e delle funzionalità applicative.

• La familiarità con il programma CMS Experimental e upgrade è un vantaggio.

• Capacità di collegare le attività operative in campo con i sistemi IT e interfacciare le procedure di gestione degli asset CERN.
Competenze tecniche:

• Conoscenza delle architetture e delle tecnologie di data mining.

• Concettualizzazione, progettazione e sviluppo di esperienze e interfacce utente.

• Decommissione e smaltimento dei componenti e dei sistemi del rivelatore.

• Sviluppo del software di applicazione.
Competenze comportamentali:

• Risultati ottenuti: definizione di obiettivi chiari, pietre miliari e realizzabili prima di avviare il lavoro/progetto.

• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci.

• Comunicare efficacemente: garantire che le informazioni, le procedure e le decisioni siano adeguatamente documentate.

• Risolvere i problemi: affrontare problemi complessi distruggendoli in componenti gestibili.

• Conoscenza dell'apprendimento e della condivisione: proporre modi per migliorare o semplificare le procedure, i processi e le metodologie esistenti.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 31.08.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: Contratto di durata limitata (4 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.

• Esposizione a campi elettromagnetici in determinate condizioni di esposizione.

• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale.
Grado di lavoro: 6-7
Riferimento del lavoro: EP-CMS-SSI-2026-166-LD
Campo di lavoro: Data Science & Data Analytics
Benchmark Titolo di lavoro: medico applicato

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
