descriptionByLocale.it:
I modelli della Fondazione rappresentano uno dei più potenti e promettenti progressi nel Deep Learning, e la loro applicazione ai domini scientifici è un'area di ricerca in rapida evoluzione.
Al gruppo IT-CE del CERN, stiamo esplorando lo sviluppo di un modello di base su misura per la fisica delle particelle: uno capace di interpretare il comportamento delle particelle all'interno dei rivelatori di Fisica ad Alta Energia (HEP) e di supportare una vasta gamma di compiti rilevanti per l'elaborazione dei dati sperimentali.
Questo lavoro è svolto in stretta collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare di esperti di istituti leader in tutta Europa nel contesto di TURING, un progetto finanziato dalla CE.
Come candidato di successo, contribuirai alla progettazione e formazione di architetture a base di trasformatori utilizzando dati da calorimetri, rivelatori specializzati che misurano l'energia delle particelle negli esperimenti di collider.
Il vostro lavoro coinvolgerà metodi di indagine come l'apprendimento self-supervised per abilitare le capacità multi-task, mentre l'ottimizzazione per l'efficienza computazionale.
Stiamo cercando candidati con un forte background in Informatica o un campo strettamente correlato. L'esperienza con Deep Learning, modelli di trasformatori o dati scientifici è altamente auspicabile. Questa posizione è disponibile immediatamente.
Le tue responsabilità:

• Prendere un ruolo attivo all'interno del progetto TURING, conducendo le attività di valutazione delle prestazioni e di validazione dei casi di utilizzo.

• Sviluppare un prototipo robusto in grado di generalizzare in diversi casi di utilizzo del rivelatore.

• Contribuire a stringere le collaborazioni con la comunità di fisica sperimentale del CERN sul tema dei modelli di fondazione per HEP.
Il tuo profilo:

• Dottorato in Scienze dei dati, Matematica o Fisica.

• Provata esperienza nello sviluppo, nella formazione e nella distribuzione di modelli di deep learning in ambienti di produzione, con competenze pratiche in architetture di rete neurali, elaborazione dati su larga scala, ottimizzazione dei modelli e valutazione delle prestazioni.
Competenze:

• Forte competenza in Python e deep learning framework (PyTorch e/o TensorFlow), algoritmi di machine learning, librerie di analisi dei dati (NumPy, Pandas), formazione basata su GPU, best practice di ingegneria del software, controllo della versione Git, strumenti Docker e MLOps per il monitoraggio degli esperimenti e la distribuzione dei modelli.

• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.
Criteri di ammissibilità:

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .

• Hai uno sfondo professionale in Data Science, Matematica o Fisica (o un campo correlato) e hanno o:
• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;

• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

Data di chiusura del lavoro: 15.09.2026 alle 23:59 CEST.
Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali
Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido
Data di inizio obiettivo: 01-Novembre-2026
Questa posizione comporta:

• In piedi, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
Riferimento del lavoro: IT-CE-CDS-2026-137-GRAP
Campo di lavoro: Data Science, AI & Analytics

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 6372-7004 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità entusiasmanti per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Grundlagenmodelle stellen einen der mächtigsten und vielversprechendsten Fortschritte im Deep Learning dar, und ihre Anwendung auf wissenschaftliche Bereiche ist ein sich schnell entwickelndes Forschungsgebiet.
In der IT-CE-Gruppe des CERN erforschen wir die Entwicklung eines auf die Teilchenphysik zugeschnittenen Grundlagenmodells: eines, das in der Lage ist, das Verhalten von Teilchen in Detektoren der Hochenergiephysik (HEP) zu interpretieren und eine Vielzahl von Aufgaben zu unterstützen, die für die experimentelle Datenverarbeitung relevant sind.
Diese Arbeit wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem multidisziplinären Team von Experten aus führenden Instituten in ganz Europa im Rahmen von TURING, einem von der EU finanzierten Projekt, durchgeführt.
Als erfolgreicher Kandidat werden Sie zum Design und Training von transformatorbasierten Architekturen beitragen, die Daten von Kalorimetern verwenden, spezialisierten Detektoren, die die Teilchenenergie in Kolliderexperimenten messen.
Ihre Arbeit umfasst die Untersuchung von Methoden wie selbstüberwachtem Lernen, um Multi-Task-Funktionen zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig die Recheneffizienz zu optimieren.
Wir suchen Kandidaten mit einem starken Hintergrund in der Informatik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung mit Deep Learning, Transformatormodellen oder wissenschaftlichen Daten ist sehr wünschenswert. Diese Position ist sofort verfügbar.
Ihre Aufgaben:

• Nehmen Sie eine aktive Rolle innerhalb des TURING-Projekts ein und leiten Sie die Leistungsbewertung und die Validierung von Anwendungsfällen.

• Entwicklung eines robusten Prototyps, der in der Lage ist, mehrere Anwendungsfälle von Detektoren zu verallgemeinern.

• Beitrag zur Verschärfung der Zusammenarbeit mit der experimentellen Physikgemeinschaft des CERN zum Thema Grundlagenmodelle für HEP.
Ihr Profil:

• PhD in Data Science, Mathematik oder Physik.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Les modèles de fondation représentent l'un des progrès les plus puissants et les plus prometteurs dans l'apprentissage profond, et leur application aux domaines scientifiques est un domaine de recherche en évolution rapide.
Au sein du groupe IT-CE du CERN, nous explorons le développement d'un modèle de base adapté à la physique des particules : un modèle capable d'interpréter le comportement des particules au sein des détecteurs de haute énergie (HEP) et de soutenir un large éventail de tâches liées au traitement expérimental des données.
Ce travail est réalisé en étroite collaboration avec une équipe multidisciplinaire d'experts de grands instituts d'Europe dans le cadre de TURING, un projet financé par la CE.
En tant que candidat retenu, vous contribuerez à la conception et à la formation d'architectures basées sur les transformateurs à l'aide de données de calorimètres, de détecteurs spécialisés qui mesurent l'énergie des particules dans les expériences de collision.
Votre travail consistera à étudier des méthodologies telles que l'apprentissage autosupervisé pour permettre des capacités multitâches, tout en optimisant l'efficacité computationnelle.
Nous recherchons des candidats ayant une solide expérience en informatique ou un domaine étroitement lié. L'expérience de l'apprentissage profond, des modèles de transformateurs ou des données scientifiques est très souhaitable. Cette position est disponible immédiatement.
Vos responsabilités :

• Jouer un rôle actif dans le projet TURING, diriger l'évaluation des performances et utiliser les tâches de validation de cas.

• Développer un prototype robuste capable de généraliser plusieurs cas d'utilisation de détecteurs.

• Contribuer à resserrer les collaborations avec la communauté de physique expérimentale du CERN sur le thème des modèles de fondation pour HEP.
Votre profil:

• Doctorat en sciences des données, mathématiques ou physique.

• Expérience éprouvée de développement, de formation et de déploiement de modèles d'apprentissage profond dans les environnements de production, avec une expertise pratique dans les architectures de réseaux neuronaux, le traitement de données à grande échelle, l'optimisation des modèles et l'évaluation des performances.
Compétences :

• Forte compétence en Python et en cadres d'apprentissage profond (PyTorch et/ou TensorFlow), algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique, bibliothèques d'analyse de données (NumPy, Pandas), formation basée sur GPU, meilleures pratiques en génie logiciel, contrôle de version Git, Docker, et outils MLOps pour le suivi des expériences et le déploiement de modèles.

• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.
Critères d'éligibilité:

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre ou associé du CERN .

• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en Data Science, Mathématiques ou Physique (ou un domaine connexe) et avez:
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;

• ou d'un doctorat d'au plus trois ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

Date de clôture de l'emploi : 15.09.2026 à 23:59 CEST.
Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation jusqu'à 36 mois maximum.
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi: Hybride
Date cible de début : 1er novembre 2026
Cette position implique:

• Obligation de disponibilité, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.

• Travaille pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.

Domaine d'activité: Data Science, AI & Analytics

• Une allocation mensuelle comprise entre 6372-004 francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.

• Couverture par le régime complet d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi un large éventail de professionnels des domaines de l'ingénierie, technique, scientifique et administratif. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.

jobs.description:
Introduction
 Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Cooling and Ventilation (EN-CV) group is responsible for the design, the building, the operation and the maintenance of the cooling and ventilation plants for large energy physics accelerators, experiments and technical facilities. The EN-CV group pursues sustainable cooling and ventilation systems enhancing energy saving and recovery.
 You will join the PSM Section (EN-CV-PSM), which is in charge of the operation and maintenance of the cooling and ventilation systems of CERN’s accelerator complex and experimental areas. The activity includes the work site supervision for installation work and commissioning of new systems, upgrade of existing systems and consolidation of old systems.
 Are you a qualified technician, specialised in industrial cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems? Contribute your skill and experience to the operation and maintenance of complex cooling plants in a unique environment hosting some of the world’s most complex technical installations. Join CERN’s Cooling and Ventilation operation team. Take part!
 Functions

• Plan (by using the CMMS system), coordinate, supervise, check and perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on cooling and ventilation systems.

• Perform operation activities to ensure appropriate running of the cooling, ventilation & refrigeration systems.

• Ensure regular liaison with clients for all matters related to equipment under your responsibility.

• Propose and define the most appropriate solution to meet user needs in case of modification or renovation works.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work in compliance with contractual clauses and technical standards.

• Contribute to projects from the design phase until test and commissioning of new cooling and ventilation systems.

• Ensure that the technical documentation is kept up-to-date and compliant with the quality standards.

• Ensure the respect of safety rules for all interventions.

• Follow up and regularly report on activities progress, schedule and costs.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Refrigeration and / or Electromechanics, or a related field.
 Having obtained the fluid handling permit, or equivalent is considered an advantage.
 Experience:

• Experience in maintenance, operation, and installation work on cooling, ventilation, and industrial systems.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Initial experience in compressed air systems.

• Experience in the operation and maintenance of refrigeration systems.

• Demonstrated experience in installation works.
 Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Design, construction, operation and maintenance of detector cooling systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Experience in work site supervision and as technical supervisor of contractors would be an advantage.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Communicating Effectively: expressing opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeping to the point.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: being able to deal with ambiguous or unpredictable situations.

• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.

• Working in Teams: working well in groups and readily fitting into a team; participating fully and taking an active role in team activities.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 23.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to asbestos.

• Exposure to lead.

• Radiation worker, category A.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: EN-CV-PSM-2026-122-LD
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

• Propose and define the most appropriate solution to meet user needs in case of modification or renovation works.

• Technically coordinate contractors’ activities for maintenance and installation work in compliance with contractual clauses and technical standards.

• Contribute to projects from the design phase until test and commissioning of new cooling and ventilation systems.

• Ensure that the technical documentation is kept up-to-date and compliant with the quality standards.

• Ensure the respect of safety rules for all interventions.

• Follow up and regularly report on activities progress, schedule and costs.

• Experience in the technical coordination of external contractors.

• Experience in the use of CMMS tools.

• Experience in low-voltage electrical systems.

• Experience in the operation and maintenance of refrigeration systems.

• Operation and maintenance of HVAC plants and networks.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Design, construction, operation and maintenance of detector cooling systems.

jobs.title: Accelerator Physicist (BE-ABP-LNO-2026-138-GRAP)
jobs.description:
You will contribute to a proposal covering the layout, optics design, performance optimisation and evaluation of a potential future collider at CERN, the Linear Collider Facility @ 380 GeV (LCF380).
 Your responsibilities

• Work on various design aspects of LCF380.

• Perform beam dynamics simulations to demonstrate its performance.

• Investigate the interaction regions (optics design, layout, for a possible dual beam delivery system) and the damping rings to optimise performance.

• Contribute to writing the summary design report.
 Your profile

• Knowledge and understanding of lepton beam dynamics and optics design, including synchrotron radiation.

• Knowledge and experience in the setup, analysis and interpretation of particle tracking studies.

• Analysis of experimental data.
 Skills

• Accelerator physics codes like MAD, Xsuite, ELEGANT, pyAT, GuineaPig, etc.

• Running simulations on an HPC.

• Good presentation skills.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 09.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 Job reference: BE-ABP-LNO-2026-138-GRAP
 Field of work: Applied Physics
 Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

jobs.title: Short Term Internship 2026
jobs.description:
One of CERN’s key missions is education. Our experts enjoy sharing their knowledge with committed and passionate students.
 If you are an undergraduate student in a technical or administrative field , and you’re looking to spend a few months training on-the-job, imagine doing your internship at CERN in Geneva. An impressive addition to your CV!
 We offer a limited number of placements in our practical training programme.
 Duration 1 – 6 months.
 !Important!: Please note that only nationals of CERN Member States or Associate Member States are eligible to apply. Applications from other countries will not be considered.

To qualify for an internship, you should meet the following requirements:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You are a full-time student (Technical/Administrative diploma, Bachelor or Master degree).
• Please note that candidates studying for a PhD are not eligible for this programme.

• You are at least 18 years of age .

• Your main field of study is in one of the following areas: applied physics, computing, mathematics, electricity, electronics, mechanical or civil engineering, instrumentation, materials science, radiation protection, safety and environmental protection, surveying, ultra-high vacuum, scientific communication. Or in administrative fields such as: translation, advanced secretarial work, accounting, legal services, human resources, librarianship, logistics.

• You will remain a full-time registered student throughout the internship at CERN .

• You have good working proficiency in English and/ or French.
 Important Information

• The duration of the internship is minimum 1 month and maximum 6 months.

• Your Educational Establishment / University must ensure you have full insurance cover valid in the Geneva area (France and Switzerland) for medical expenses, work and private accidents as well as any disability arising from professional and non-professional illness and accidents.

• You will receive a monthly allowance of 1,593 Swiss Francs for a full month of work. If you work less than a full month, the allowance will be adjusted proportionally.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, you will only be contacted if successful.
 Please note that if a traineeship agreement is required by your Educational Establishment / University, as an international organisation CERN will not sign external documents . You will therefore be required to use the CERN traineeship agreement provided on https://cds.cern.ch/record/1994294/files/convention_stage_6mois_en.pdf .
 How to apply
 You need a CV in English or French (in a PDF format).
 During the application process you will need to select your availability period for this internship.

Global Benefits

• A monthly allowance of 1,593 Swiss Francs.

• Entitlement to paid leave for contracts of 4 months or more.

• Sei uno studente a tempo pieno (diploma tecnico/amministrativo, laurea o master).
• Si prega di notare che i candidati che studiano per un dottorato non sono idonei per questo programma.

• Hai almeno 18 anni di età.

• Il vostro principale campo di studio è in uno dei seguenti settori: fisica applicata, elaborazione, matematica, elettricità, elettronica, ingegneria meccanica o civile, strumentazione, scienza dei materiali, protezione dalle radiazioni, sicurezza e protezione ambientale, indagine, ultra-alto vuoto, comunicazione scientifica. O in settori amministrativi come: traduzione, lavoro di segreteria avanzato, contabilità, servizi legali, risorse umane, bibliotecaria, logistica.

• Rimarrai uno studente registrato a tempo pieno durante lo stage presso il CERN .

• Hai una buona competenza lavorativa in inglese e/o francese.
Informazioni importanti

• La durata dello stage è di minimo 1 mese e massimo 6 mesi.

• La vostra istituzione educativa / Università deve assicurarsi di avere copertura assicurativa completa valida nella zona di Ginevra (Francia e Svizzera) per le spese mediche, il lavoro e gli incidenti privati, nonché qualsiasi disabilità derivante da malattie professionali e non professionali e incidenti.

• Riceverai un'indennità mensile di 1,593 franchi svizzeri per un mese intero di lavoro. Se si lavora meno di un mese intero, l'indennità sarà regolata proporzionalmente.

A causa dell'elevato volume di applicazioni che riceviamo, sarete contattati solo se successo.
Si prega di notare che se un contratto di tirocinio è richiesto dalla vostra istituzione educativa / Università, come un'organizzazione internazionale CERN non firmerà documenti esterni. Sarà pertanto richiesto di utilizzare l'accordo di tirocinio del CERN fornito su https://cds.cern.ch/record/1994294/files/convention stage 6mois en.pdf .
Come applicare
Hai bisogno di un CV in inglese o francese (in formato PDF).
Durante il processo di applicazione è necessario selezionare il periodo di disponibilità per questo stage.

Vantaggi globali

• Assegno mensile di 1.593 franchi svizzeri.

• Entrata in congedo retribuito per contratti di 4 mesi o più.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!

descriptionByLocale.en:
One of CERN’s key missions is education. Our experts enjoy sharing their knowledge with committed and passionate students.
If you are an undergraduate student in a technical or administrative field , and you’re looking to spend a few months training on-the-job, imagine doing your internship at CERN in Geneva. An impressive addition to your CV!
We offer a limited number of placements in our practical training programme.
Duration 1 – 6 months.
!Important!: Please note that only nationals of CERN Member States or Associate Member States are eligible to apply. Applications from other countries will not be considered.

To qualify for an internship, you should meet the following requirements:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You are a full-time student (Technical/Administrative diploma, Bachelor or Master degree).
• Please note that candidates studying for a PhD are not eligible for this programme.

• You are at least 18 years of age .

• Your main field of study is in one of the following areas: applied physics, computing, mathematics, electricity, electronics, mechanical or civil engineering, instrumentation, materials science, radiation protection, safety and environmental protection, surveying, ultra-high vacuum, scientific communication. Or in administrative fields such as: translation, advanced secretarial work, accounting, legal services, human resources, librarianship, logistics.

• You will remain a full-time registered student throughout the internship at CERN .

• You have good working proficiency in English and/ or French.
Important Information

• The duration of the internship is minimum 1 month and maximum 6 months.

• Your Educational Establishment / University must ensure you have full insurance cover valid in the Geneva area (France and Switzerland) for medical expenses, work and private accidents as well as any disability arising from professional and non-professional illness and accidents.

• You will receive a monthly allowance of 1,593 Swiss Francs for a full month of work. If you work less than a full month, the allowance will be adjusted proportionally.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, you will only be contacted if successful.
Please note that if a traineeship agreement is required by your Educational Establishment / University, as an international organisation CERN will not sign external documents . You will therefore be required to use the CERN traineeship agreement provided on https://cds.cern.ch/record/1994294/files/convention_stage_6mois_en.pdf .
How to apply
You need a CV in English or French (in a PDF format).
During the application process you will need to select your availability period for this internship.

Global Benefits

• A monthly allowance of 1,593 Swiss Francs.

• Entitlement to paid leave for contracts of 4 months or more.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine der wichtigsten Missionen des CERN ist Bildung. Unsere Experten teilen ihr Wissen gerne mit engagierten und leidenschaftlichen Studenten.
Wenn Sie ein Student in einem technischen oder administrativen Bereich sind und ein paar Monate am Arbeitsplatz trainieren möchten, stellen Sie sich vor, Sie machen Ihr Praktikum am CERN in Genf. Eine beeindruckende Ergänzung zu Ihrem CV!
Wir bieten eine begrenzte Anzahl von Praktika in unserem praktischen Trainingsprogramm an.
Dauer 1 – 6 Monate.
!Wichtig!: Bitte beachten Sie, dass nur Staatsangehörige von CERN-Mitgliedstaaten oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten einen Antrag stellen können. Anträge aus anderen Ländern werden nicht berücksichtigt.

Um sich für ein Praktikum zu qualifizieren, sollten Sie die folgenden Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitglieds oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats.

• Sie sind Vollzeitstudent (Technisches / Verwaltungsdiplom, Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss).
• Bitte beachten Sie, dass Kandidaten, die für einen PhD studieren, nicht für dieses Programm in Frage kommen.

• Sie sind mindestens 18 Jahre alt.

• Ihr Hauptstudium liegt in einem der folgenden Bereiche: Angewandte Physik, Informatik, Mathematik, Elektrizität, Elektronik, Maschinenbau oder Bauingenieurwesen, Instrumentierung, Materialwissenschaft, Strahlenschutz, Sicherheit und Umweltschutz, Vermessung, Ultrahochvakuum, wissenschaftliche Kommunikation. Oder in Verwaltungsbereichen wie Übersetzung, fortgeschrittene Sekretariatsarbeit, Buchhaltung, juristische Dienstleistungen, Personal, Bibliothekswesen, Logistik.

• Sie bleiben ein Vollzeit-registrierter Student während des Praktikums am CERN.

• Sie haben gute Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch und / oder Französisch.
Wichtige Informationen

• Die Dauer des Praktikums beträgt mindestens 1 Monat und maximal 6 Monate.

• Ihre Bildungseinrichtung / Universität muss sicherstellen, dass Sie einen vollständigen Versicherungsschutz haben, der im Raum Genf (Frankreich und Schweiz) für medizinische Kosten, Arbeits- und Privatunfälle sowie für Behinderungen aufgrund von Berufs- und Nichtberufskrankheiten und -unfällen gilt.

• Sie erhalten eine monatliche Zulage von 1.593 Schweizer Franken für einen vollen Monat Arbeit. Wenn Sie weniger als einen vollen Monat arbeiten, wird die Zulage proportional angepasst.

Aufgrund des hohen Volumens an Bewerbungen, die wir erhalten, werden Sie nur bei Erfolg kontaktiert.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass, wenn eine Praktikumsvereinbarung von Ihrer Bildungseinrichtung / Universität erforderlich ist, als internationale Organisation CERN keine externen Dokumente unterzeichnen wird. Sie müssen daher die CERN-Praktikavereinbarung unter https://cds.cern.ch/record/1994294/files/convention stage 6mois en.pdf nutzen.
Wie man anwendet
Sie benötigen einen Lebenslauf in Englisch oder Französisch (im PDF-Format).
Während des Bewerbungsprozesses müssen Sie Ihren Verfügbarkeitszeitraum für dieses Praktikum auswählen.

Globale Vorteile

• Eine monatliche Zulage von 1.593 Schweizer Franken.

• Anspruch auf bezahlten Urlaub bei Verträgen von 4 Monaten oder mehr.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!
Mehr Informationen über uns, hier: careers.cern

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about software development? Are you interested in supporting open science and reproducible computational research across Europe? Join our team working on the open-source REANA platform for reproducible computational data analyses! You will specifically take part in the nascent European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) Federation and the EOSC Mesh project which is designing federated digital infrastructures to cross-link research environments across Europe.
 Your responsibilities
 As a full-stack developer in our team, you will:

• Collaborate with European Open Science Cloud project partners on developing cross-node federated analysis workflow infrastructure and support corresponding scientific use cases.

• Participate in the evolution the CERN Node of the EOSC Federation, allowing researchers to analyse more than 5 petabytes of open data from experimental particle physics.

• Contribute to the service deployment, operations and monitoring on the Kubernetes cloud.

• Work closely with researchers to provide support for cross-node computational data analysis examples.

• Participate in the operation and development of the REANA reproducible data analysis platform.
 More information here .
 Your profile

• Experience in full-stack software development and with frontend and backend software engineering technologies.

• Experience with container technologies and application deployment, monitoring and security.

• Some familiarity with basic principles of computational research data analyses would be a plus.

• Some prior experience working in European Commission co-funded projects would be a plus.
 Skills

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with an interest in collaborative open-source development.

• Frontend development technologies: React.

• Backend development technologies: Python, Go.

• Application deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science or equivalent (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

jobs.title: Computing Engineer: S3 Storage & Backup (IT-SD-TAB-2026-209-GRAE)
jobs.description:
Join CERN's Storage and Data Management group, to develop the next-generation backup solution for services across the laboratory. The Storage and Data Management Group is responsible for enabling data access for the laboratory, in particular the long-term archival, preservation and distribution of LHC data to a worldwide scientific community. CERN, take part!
 As a Computing Engineer (S3 Storage and Backup Systems), you will join the Tape Archive and Backup (TAB) section, responsible for the CERN Tape Archive software and the management of 1.5 Petabytes of data in cold storage. Your job will include R&D, software development and operations tasks.
 The Backup team are developing a future on-premises backup solution based on tiered storage accessed via a S3 API. Hot data is kept on disk and cold data will be migrated to cold storage (tape). You will work on solving technical problems, contributing new software features, and testing and commissioning the new system.
 On the operations side, you will be involved in monitoring and performance analysis, troubleshooting problems and diagnosing the cause of any system failures. This includes interaction with services in the Storage and Data Management group and across CERN.
 Your responsibilities:

• Integrating backup orchestration with disk and tape storage.

• Developing and maintaining software in C++/Linux, client and server.

• Systems integration, configuration management, testing, monitoring and alerting of the new backup system.

• Contributing to planning the migration of existing services to the new backup solution.

• Participating in operations, troubleshooting and support as part of a team.

• Contributing to procedures and documentation.
 Your profile:

• You are experienced in software development with C++ and Python on Linux.

• Ideally you have experience of S3 object storage.

• Additional experience that would be advantageous: Ceph, systems integration, backup systems, tiered storage systems.
 Skills:

• C++ software development.

• Linux systems administration.

• Scripting in Bash and Python.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Skills which would be an advantage (but not required; training will be provided where necessary):

• Experience with S3 API, preferably including cold storage (Glacier) extensions.

• Knowledge of databases (SQL).

• Experience with version control systems (e.g. git).

• Experience with containers (e.g. Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of monitoring tools (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus).
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science or Software Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

jobs.title: Experienced Industrial Electrical Technician (EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD)
jobs.description:
Introduction
 Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Electrical Engineering (EL) group is responsible for managing CERN’s electrical distribution network, ranging from 400 kV to 400/230 V, which includes its operation, maintenance, renovation, control as well as forecasting energy consumption and handling relations with suppliers. Additionally, the group oversees the cabling infrastructure, managing everything from the installation and removal of control, water-cooled, and fiber optic cables to the maintenance of their supporting structures.

You will join the Maintenance and Operation (EN-EL-MO) section, responsible for the operation and maintenance of CERN’s electrical network, the commissioning of new installations, and the execution of small-scale electrical works.
 As an experienced industrial electrical technician in the EN-EL-MO section, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining part of CERN's high- and low-voltage electrical network.
 Apply your expertise to support the operation, maintenance, consolidation and development of CERN’s electrical transmission and distribution systems, the backbone of one of the world’s largest and most powerful particle colliders. Join the CERN electrical engineering team. Take part!
 Functions
 As responsible for maintaining and operating a portion of CERN's electrical network, you will:

• Operate the high- and low-voltage network (lockouts, switching electrical equipment on and off, network reconfiguration).

• Perform troubleshooting and repairs, document interventions, and lead or contribute to the preparation of technical reports.

• Carry out regular inspections to ensure the reliability and safety of the electrical network.

• Act as the contact person for users connected to the electrical network within the assigned area.

• Supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities, as well as electrical works.

• Contribute to electrical projects executed by the Group: participate in project meetings, assist in the definition of technical solutions, prepare and execute tests and commissioning activities, and perform acceptance tests on high- and low-voltage installations.

• Maintain accurate records of maintenance and operational activities, including work performed, issues encountered, and corrective actions taken.

Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Good knowledge of high- and low-voltage electrical distribution systems and associated equipment.

• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of electrical installations, including troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repairs, and commissioning activities.

• Demonstrated ability to work autonomously while coordinating activities with users, contractors, and technical specialists in a multidisciplinary environment.

• Experience using a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for recording maintenance and operational activities.

• Experience in reading, updating, and managing electrical drawings, technical documentation, and as-built records.
 Technical competencies:

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Construction, test and commissioning of electrical circuits and networks.

• Knowledge of Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
 Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: driving work / projects along and seeing them through to their conclusion.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: demonstrating a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supporting initiatives for change.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
 Language skills:
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 06.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
 Employment Conditions
 Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
 Working Hours: 40 hours per week
 Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
 This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job grade: 3-4
 Job reference: EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD
 Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
 Benchmark Job Title: Electrical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
All’interno del dipartimento di Ingegneria CERN (EN), il gruppo di Ingegneria Elettrica (EL) è responsabile della gestione della rete di distribuzione elettrica del CERN, che va da 400 kV a 400/230 V, che comprende il suo funzionamento, manutenzione, ristrutturazione, controllo e la previsione del consumo energetico e la gestione delle relazioni con i fornitori. Inoltre, il gruppo supervisiona l'infrastruttura di cablaggio, gestendo tutto dall'installazione e rimozione dei cavi, raffreddati ad acqua e fibra ottica al mantenimento delle loro strutture di supporto.

Vi unirete alla sezione Manutenzione e Operazione (EN-EL-MO), responsabile del funzionamento e della manutenzione della rete elettrica del CERN, della messa in servizio di nuove installazioni e dell’esecuzione di piccoli impianti elettrici.
In qualità di esperto tecnico elettrico industriale nella sezione EN-EL-MO, sarete responsabili di operare e mantenere parte della rete elettrica ad alta e bassa tensione del CERN.
Applica la tua esperienza per supportare il funzionamento, la manutenzione, il consolidamento e lo sviluppo dei sistemi di trasmissione e distribuzione elettrica del CERN, la spina dorsale di uno dei più grandi e potenti collider di particelle al mondo. Unisciti al team di ingegneria elettrica del CERN. Prendi parte!
Funzioni
Come responsabile del mantenimento e del funzionamento di una parte della rete elettrica del CERN, Lei:

• Operare la rete ad alta e bassa tensione (blocchi, accensione e spegnimento di apparecchiature elettriche, riconfigurazione di rete).

• Eseguire la risoluzione dei problemi e le riparazioni, gli interventi dei documenti, e portare o contribuire alla preparazione dei rapporti tecnici.

• Eseguire ispezioni regolari per garantire l'affidabilità e la sicurezza della rete elettrica.

• Agire come persona di contatto per gli utenti collegati alla rete elettrica all'interno dell'area assegnata.

• Superare attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, nonché lavori elettrici.

• Contribuire a progetti elettrici eseguiti dal Gruppo: partecipare a riunioni di progetto, assistere alla definizione di soluzioni tecniche, preparare ed eseguire test e attività di messa in servizio, e eseguire test di accettazione su impianti ad alta e bassa tensione.

• Mantenere registri accurati di attività di manutenzione e di funzionamento, tra cui il lavoro svolto, i problemi incontrati e le azioni correttive intraprese.

Certificato tecnico o istruzione secondaria generale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o di un campo correlato.

Esperienza:

• Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di distribuzione elettrica ad alta e bassa tensione e delle attrezzature associate.

• Esperienza comprovata nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di impianti elettrici, tra cui la risoluzione dei problemi, la diagnosi dei guasti, le riparazioni e le attività di messa in servizio.

• Dimostrata capacità di lavorare autonomamente mentre coordina le attività con utenti, appaltatori e specialisti tecnici in un ambiente multidisciplinare.

• Esperienza utilizzando un sistema di gestione della manutenzione informatizzata (CMMS) per la registrazione delle attività di manutenzione e di funzionamento.

• Esperienza nella lettura, l'aggiornamento e la gestione di disegni elettrici, documentazione tecnica e record as-built.
Competenze tecniche:

• Funzionamento e manutenzione di circuiti elettrici e reti.

• Costruzione, test e messa in servizio di circuiti elettrici e reti.

• Conoscenza del sistema di gestione della manutenzione computerizzata (CMMS).
Competenze comportamentali:

• Risultati: lavoro di guida / progetti lungo e vederli attraverso alla loro conclusione.

• Dimostrare la responsabilità: assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni e decisioni.

• Dimostrare Flessibilità: dimostrare la volontà di accettare circostanze mutevoli; sostenere iniziative di cambiamento.

• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci.
Capacità linguistiche:
Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese.

Ammissibilità e chiusura:
La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati.
Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 06.09.2026 a 23:59 CEST .
Condizioni di lavoro
Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato.
Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana
Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco
Questa posizione comporta:

• Partecipazione ad un regolare servizio di stand-by, comprese le notti, la domenica e le festività ufficiali.

• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

• Una patente di guida valida.

• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.

• Esposizione a campi elettromagnetici in determinate condizioni di esposizione.

• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale.
Grado di lavoro: 3-4
Riferimento del lavoro: EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD
Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica
Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: tecnico elettrico

Vantaggi globali

• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato.
Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile!
Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano.
Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo.
Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita!
Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
Innerhalb der Abteilung CERN Engineering (EN) ist die Gruppe Elektrotechnik (EL) für die Verwaltung des elektrischen Verteilungsnetzes des CERN von 400 kV bis 400/230 V verantwortlich, das den Betrieb, die Wartung, die Renovierung, die Steuerung sowie die Vorhersage des Energieverbrauchs und die Abwicklung der Beziehungen zu Lieferanten umfasst. Darüber hinaus überwacht die Gruppe die Kabelinfrastruktur und verwaltet alles von der Installation und Entfernung von Steuerungs-, Wasser- und Glasfaserkabeln bis hin zur Wartung ihrer tragenden Strukturen.

Sie werden der Abteilung Wartung und Betrieb (EN-EL-MO) beitreten, die für den Betrieb und die Wartung des elektrischen Netzes des CERN, die Inbetriebnahme neuer Installationen und die Durchführung kleiner elektrischer Arbeiten verantwortlich ist.
Als erfahrener Elektrotechniker im Bereich EN-EL-MO sind Sie für den Betrieb und die Wartung eines Teils des Hoch- und Niederspannungsnetzes des CERN verantwortlich.
Wenden Sie Ihr Fachwissen an, um den Betrieb, die Wartung, die Konsolidierung und die Entwicklung der elektrischen Übertragungs- und Verteilungssysteme des CERN, dem Rückgrat eines der weltweit größten und leistungsstärksten Teilchenbeschleuniger, zu unterstützen. Treten Sie dem Elektrotechnik-Team des CERN bei. Nimm teil!
Funktionen
Als Verantwortliche für die Wartung und den Betrieb eines Teils des elektrischen Netzes des CERN werden Sie:

• Betrieb des Hoch- und Niederspannungsnetzes (Lockouts, Ein- und Ausschalten von elektrischen Geräten, Netzrekonfiguration).

• Führen Sie Fehlersuche und Reparaturen durch, dokumentieren Sie Interventionen und führen Sie oder tragen Sie zur Erstellung von technischen Berichten bei.

• Führen Sie regelmäßige Inspektionen durch, um die Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit des elektrischen Netzes zu gewährleisten.

• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner für Benutzer, die an das elektrische Netzwerk innerhalb des zugewiesenen Bereichs angeschlossen sind.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie vorbeugende und korrigierende Wartungsarbeiten sowie elektrische Arbeiten.

• Beitrag zu von der Gruppe durchgeführten Elektroprojekten: Teilnahme an Projektbesprechungen, Unterstützung bei der Definition technischer Lösungen, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Tests und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten sowie Durchführung von Abnahmetests bei Hoch- und Niederspannungsinstallationen.

• Führen Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen über Instandhaltungs- und Betriebstätigkeiten, einschließlich durchgeführter Arbeiten, aufgetretener Probleme und ergriffener Korrekturmaßnahmen.

Technisches Zertifikat oder allgemeine Sekundarschulbildung oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Gebiet.

Erfahrung:

• Gute Kenntnisse der elektrischen Hoch- und Niederspannungsverteilungssysteme und der zugehörigen Geräte.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Wartung von Elektroinstallationen, einschließlich Fehlerbehebung, Fehlerdiagnose, Reparaturen und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig Aktivitäten mit Benutzern, Auftragnehmern und technischen Spezialisten in einem multidisziplinären Umfeld zu koordinieren.

• Erfahrung mit einem Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) zur Aufzeichnung von Wartungs- und Betriebsaktivitäten.

• Erfahrung im Lesen, Aktualisieren und Verwalten elektrischer Zeichnungen, technischer Dokumentation und eingebauter Aufzeichnungen.
Technische Kompetenzen:

• Betrieb und Wartung von Stromkreisen und Netzen.

• Bau, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme von Stromkreisen und Netzen.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
Verhaltenskompetenzen:

• Ergebnisse erzielen: Arbeiten / Projekte vorantreiben und bis zum Abschluss begleiten.

• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: Übernahme von Verantwortung für eigene Handlungen und Entscheidungen.

• Flexibilität demonstrieren: Bereitschaft zeigen, sich ändernde Umstände zu akzeptieren; Initiativen für Veränderungen unterstützen.

• Arbeiten in Teams: Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver und effektiver Arbeitsbeziehungen.
Sprachkenntnisse:
Englisch gesprochen und geschrieben, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag:
Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten.
Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 06.09.2026 um 23:59 Uhr MESZ erreichen.
Beschäftigungsbedingungen
Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (5 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen.
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort
Diese Position umfasst:

• Teilnahme an einem regulären Bereitschaftsdienst, einschließlich Nächten, Sonntagen und Feiertagen.

• Arbeiten in Strahlungsgebieten.

• Eingriffe in unterirdische Anlagen.

• Ein gültiger Führerschein.

• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern.

• Exposition gegenüber elektromagnetischen Feldern unter bestimmten Expositionsbedingungen.

• Angesichts der mit dieser Position verbundenen beruflichen Gesundheitsrisiken muss der ausgewählte Kandidat eine ärztliche Genehmigung einholen, bevor ein Vertragsangebot bestätigt wird.
Job Grade: 3-4
Arbeitsnummer: EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD
Arbeitsgebiet: Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik
Benchmark Job Title: Elektrotechniker

Globale Vorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer zu verlängern.
Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird!
Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen.
Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL!

Présentation
Au sein du département d'ingénierie du CERN (EN), le groupe d'ingénierie électrique (EL) est chargé de la gestion du réseau de distribution électrique du CERN, qui va de 400 kV à 400/230 V, ce qui comprend son fonctionnement, son entretien, sa rénovation, son contrôle ainsi que la prévision de la consommation d'énergie et des relations de manutention avec les fournisseurs. De plus, le groupe supervise l'infrastructure de câblage, en gérant tout, depuis l'installation et l'enlèvement des câbles de commande, refroidis par eau et à fibres optiques jusqu'à l'entretien de leurs structures de support.

Vous rejoindrez la section Maintenance et fonctionnement (EN-EL-MO), responsable de l'exploitation et de l'entretien du réseau électrique du CERN, de la mise en service de nouvelles installations et de l'exécution de petits travaux électriques.
En tant que technicien industriel en électricité expérimenté dans la section EN-EL-MO, vous serez responsable du fonctionnement et de l'entretien d'une partie du réseau électrique haute et basse tension du CERN.
Appliquez votre expertise pour soutenir le fonctionnement, la maintenance, la consolidation et le développement des systèmes de transmission et de distribution électriques du CERN, l'épine dorsale de l'un des plus grands et des plus puissants collisions de particules au monde. Rejoignez l'équipe de génie électrique du CERN. Participez !
Fonctions
En tant que responsable de l'entretien et de l'exploitation d'une partie du réseau électrique du CERN, vous:

• Fonctionnement du réseau haute et basse tension (verrouillages, mise en marche et arrêt de l'équipement électrique, reconfiguration du réseau).

• Effectuer le dépannage et les réparations, documenter les interventions et diriger ou contribuer à la préparation des rapports techniques.

• Effectuer des inspections régulières pour assurer la fiabilité et la sécurité du réseau électrique.

• Agir comme personne de contact pour les utilisateurs connectés au réseau électrique dans la zone assignée.

• Superviser les activités de maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que les travaux électriques.

• Contribuer aux projets électriques exécutés par le Groupe : participer à des réunions de projet, aider à la définition de solutions techniques, préparer et exécuter des essais et des activités de mise en service, et effectuer des essais d'acceptation sur des installations à haute et basse tension.

• Tenir des registres exacts des activités de maintenance et d'exploitation, y compris les travaux effectués, les problèmes rencontrés et les mesures correctives prises.

Certificat technique ou enseignement secondaire général ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du génie électrique ou un domaine connexe.

Expérience :

• Bonne connaissance des systèmes de distribution électrique à haute et basse tension et de l'équipement connexe.

• Expérience éprouvée dans le fonctionnement et l'entretien d'installations électriques, y compris le dépannage, le diagnostic de défaillance, les réparations et les activités de mise en service.

• Capacité démontrée de travailler de façon autonome tout en coordonnant les activités avec les utilisateurs, les entrepreneurs et les spécialistes techniques dans un environnement multidisciplinaire.

• Expérience de l'utilisation d'un système informatisé de gestion de la maintenance (CMMS) pour enregistrer la maintenance et les activités opérationnelles.

• Expérience de la lecture, de la mise à jour et de la gestion des dessins électriques, de la documentation technique et des documents tels que construits.
Compétences techniques:

• Fonctionnement et entretien des circuits et réseaux électriques.

• Construction, essais et mise en service de circuits et réseaux électriques.

• Connaissance du système informatisé de gestion de la maintenance (CMMS).
Compétences comportementales :

• Atteindre des résultats: conduire des travaux / projets le long et les voir jusqu'à leur conclusion.

• Démontrer la responsabilité : prendre la responsabilité de ses propres actions et décisions.

• Démontrer la souplesse : démontrer la volonté d'accepter des circonstances changeantes; appuyer les initiatives de changement.

• Travailler en équipe : établir et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces.
Compétences linguistiques :
Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français.

Admissibilité et date de clôture:
La diversité fait partie intégrante de la mission du CERN depuis sa fondation et constitue une valeur établie pour l'Organisation. Notre réussite repose sur l'emploi d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons favorablement les candidatures de tous les États membres et États membres associés .
Ce poste sera pourvu dès que possible, et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 06.09.2026 à 23:59 CEST .
Conditions d'emploi
Type de contrat: Contrat à durée limitée (5 ans). Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un emploi pour une durée indéterminée.
Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine
Flexibilité de l'emploi : entièrement sur place
Cette position implique:

• Participation à un service régulier de réserve, y compris les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés.

• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.

• Interventions dans des installations souterraines.

• Un permis de conduire valide.

• Travaillez pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.

• Exposition aux champs électromagnétiques dans certaines conditions d'exposition.

• Compte tenu des risques pour la santé au travail associés à ce poste, le candidat sélectionné doit obtenir une attestation médicale avant de confirmer une offre de contrat.
Niveau d'emploi: 3-4
Référence de l'emploi: EN-EL-MO-2026-164-LD
Domaine de travail: génie électrique ou électronique
Titre du poste-repère : Technicien en électricité

Avantages globaux

• Un salaire compétitif (sans impôt), augmentant en fonction de vos années d'expérience pertinente.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Un forfait de réinstallation (subvention d'installation, déménagement, frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 8 ans + éligibilité à un contrat de durée indéterminée.
Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible !
Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.
Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît !
